999008199.text: はぁ～、火って落ち着くわね……

localizations.en: Ahh... there's nothing like a good fire to put you at ease...

999008199.text:
（思えばここまで色々あったわ。
　果ての大陸を目指してたどり着いた暗黒の氷海――）

localizations.en: (When I think about everything that's happened... sailing through the Midnight Sea in search of World's End--)

999008199.text:
（そこで見つけた「九偉人図」の切れ端。
　これを完成させるのが果ての大陸へ渡る鍵……）

localizations.en: (Finding those fragments of the Portrait of the Nine. Putting them all together was the key to reaching World's End...)

999008199.text:
（最後は私の兄と姉にあたるヘルトとゼロと戦って
　すべての「九偉人図」と、兄弟が揃った）

localizations.en: (And in the end, fighting Held and Zero—my own brothers and sisters—before finally reuniting all nine of us...)

999008199.text:
（あとは「九偉人図」が指示した場所、暗黒の氷海に
　もう一度乗り込むだけ！）

localizations.en: (Now all that's left is heading back to the Midnight Sea, right where the Portrait pointed us!)

999008199.text:
色々あったけど、兄弟みんなで
協力できることになって、よかった……

localizations.en: After everything we've been through... I'm just glad we're all working together now.

999008199.text:
しみじみしてるところ悪いんだけど、
だからって全員うちに招かれても困るんですがねえ？

localizations.en: Hate to interrupt your moment of reflection, but could we maybe not have everyone crash at our place next time?

999008199.text:
うっ……いやあ、みんな私が暮らしてる家を見たいって
聞かないもんだから……

localizations.en: Ugh... look, they all wanted to see where I live, and I couldn't exactly say no...

999008199.text: あと、焼いといてって頼んでたマシュマロは？

localizations.en: And what happened to those marshmallows I asked you to toast?

999008199.text: ……美味しかったわ
この食いしん坊に頼んだ私が悪かったわ！

localizations.en: I should've known better than to trust you with snacks!

999008199.text:
こちらが無理言って押し掛けたんだ。
もてなそうとしなくても構わない

localizations.en: We're the ones who insisted on coming. You don't need to go out of your way for us.

999008199.text: だね。こうして外で食べるのも乙なもんだよ

localizations.en: Agreed. There's something charming about eating out here like this.

999008199.text:
あれもこれもうまいのう！
いくらでも食べられそうじゃ！

localizations.en: Everything tastes wonderful! I could eat forever!

999008199.text: えへへっ、ありがとうございます！

フロッケちゃん、
私もお料理運ぶの、手伝うよ！

localizations.en: Flocke, let me help carry some of the dishes!

999008199.text: はい、どうぞ！

悪くない。まあ、俺の料理にはかなわないがな。
そうだろ、シトリン？

localizations.en: Not bad. Though it still doesn't hold a candle to my cooking. Isn't that right, Citrine?

999008199.text:
さあ？　ヘルトのスープは思い出の味ってだけで、
料理自体はフロッケのほうが上手いと思うけど？

localizations.en: Hmm, I dunno. Your soup might have the nostalgia factor going for it, but Flocke's the better cook, hands down.

999008199.text:
なんだと……言ってくれるじゃないか。
フロッケ、後でこれのレシピを教えろ

localizations.en: ...Bold words. Flocke, teach me this recipe later.

999008199.text: はいっ、フロッケにできることなら！

localizations.en: Of course! Anything Flocke can do to help!

999008199.text: 美味しそうな匂い……またお腹空いてきちゃった！

localizations.en: That smells amazing... now I'm hungry all over again!

999008199.text:
つまみ食いしといてこれかよ……
あんまり食べるとランツェやフロッケの分もなくなるよ

localizations.en: You already snuck food and now this... Keep it up and there won't be anything left for Lanze and Flocke.

999008199.text: あれ？　そういえばランツェは？

localizations.en: Hm? Speaking of which, where is Lanze?

999008199.text: 呼んだか？
おぉ～
ランツェのくせに……

るせぇ、似合わねえのは分かってるよ！　果ての大陸
出航記念式典に出るからには正装が必要なんだっての！

localizations.en: Yeah, yeah, I know it doesn't suit me! But if I'm going to the World's End departure ceremony, I need to dress the part!

999008199.text:
いや、似合ってないとは言ってないって。
むしろかっこいい、決まってるって言おうとしたのよ

localizations.en: No, I wasn't going to say that. I was going to say you look sharp. Really sharp, actually.

999008199.text:
それじゃいつもの格好が
かっこ悪いってことになるだろうが

localizations.en: So my usual look's not good enough, is that what you're saying?

999008199.text: そんなことないって！　シブいよ、いつものも！

localizations.en: That's not what she meant! You always look great!

999008199.text:
しかし、記念式典かあ……いよいよ果ての大陸への
出発が近づいてきてるのね

localizations.en: Still though... a ceremony. It really is hitting me now—we're almost ready to set sail.

999008199.text:
ああ、準備は万全だ。行けっていうなら
今からだって漕ぎ出せるぜ

localizations.en: Yep, everything's in order. Say the word and we can push off right now.

999008199.text: その服で指揮をとるのはキツいんじゃないの、船長

localizations.en: In that outfit? I'd hate to see you try to captain a ship in that, skipper.

999008199.text: 動きづれぇ！って、服を破きだしたりして

localizations.en: One wrong move and you'll tear right through it!

999008199.text: するか！　大切な一張羅だぞ！

localizations.en: I will not! It's my best suit!

999008199.text: 確認できましたね。ヴァレリアのもう１つの家族が

localizations.en: It's good to see it confirmed. Valeria has another family here as well.

999008199.text: 肯定……楽しそうで何より

localizations.en: Affirmative... and they appear to be enjoying themselves. That is all that matters.
